title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Minor Goblin Official PSV - Pharaoh's Servant PSV-052 Regular Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card is a 1st Edition Minor Goblin Official from the PSV - Pharaoh's Servant set. It is a Common card with a card number of PSV-052 and a finish of Regular. The card is in English language and manufactured by Konami. It features a Trap card type and is not autographed. 

The card is perfect for collectors and players alike, and is a must-have for any Yu-Gi-Oh! fan. Its Japanese card size and unique features make it a valuable addition to any collection. Don't miss out on the chance to own this rare card!
